snippet.title: you're about to see Germany's football history👀❤️‍🔥⚽️ #gnabry #terstegen #DFB #adidas
snippet.description:
German national team goalkeeper Marc-André ter Stegen and Germany forward Serge Gnabry take a look inside the adidas Archive in Herzogenaurach, discovering iconic DFB jerseys, legendary football boots and hidden pieces from German football history.
From the first DFB jersey with the iconic three adidas stripes to the 1990 FIFA World Cup era, the 2006 Teamgeist Germany jersey and the 2014 FIFA World Cup jersey worn by Toni Kroos, the archive brings together decades of adidas and German national team history.
ter Stegen and Gnabry explore jerseys from the Germany men’s and women’s national teams, including the 1980 DFB Germany jersey, the 1990 Germany World Cup training jersey connected to Rudi Völler, the 2006 Germany away jersey inspired by the Teamgeist era, the 1999 DFB Women’s jersey, the 2001 Birgit Prinz jersey and the 2014 Toni Kroos Germany jersey from the World Cup in Brazil.
They also discover 1954 World Cup football boots from the “Miracle of Bern”, an early version of the adidas Samba, signed and personalised DFB jerseys, iconic adidas football boots and other hidden gems from the adidas Archive.
From the 1954 World Cup and the Miracle of Bern to Toni Kroos, Rudi Völler, Birgit Prinz, Teamgeist and modern football, join ter Stegen and Gnabry as they explore the stories, players, boots and jerseys behind German football history.

#football #germany #archive #footballhistory

snippet.title: GRACIAS 10: Lionel Messi's Final Goodbye to Argentina | adidas
snippet.description:
GRACIAS 10 acompaña los últimos días de Lionel Messi con la Selección Argentina a través de las voces de sus compañeros y cuerpo técnico, y de los emotivos homenajes dentro y fuera de la cancha.

Desde su último día en el Predio de AFA y su llegada al Estadio Monumental, hasta Rosario, la ciudad donde comenzó su historia.

Recuerdos, anécdotas y momentos únicos recorren el camino de quienes crecieron admirando a Messi y luego tuvieron la oportunidad de jugar a su lado.

Más que la historia de un partido, GRACIAS 10 es un documental sobre Lionel Messi, su legado con Argentina y todo lo que sucede cuando llega el momento de decir gracias.

///

GRACIAS 10 follows Lionel Messi's final days with the Argentina National Team through the voices of his teammates and coaching staff, capturing the emotional tributes unfolding both on and off the pitch.

From his final day at the AFA Training Center and his arrival at the iconic Estadio Monumental to Rosario, the city where his story began.

Memories, personal stories and unforgettable moments reveal the journey of those who grew up watching Messi and later had the opportunity to play alongside him.

More than the story of a single match, GRACIAS 10 is a documentary about Lionel Messi, his legacy with Argentina and everything that happens when the time comes to say thank you.

Anthony Edwards opens Minnatlantasota with a monologue that leaves nobody out.
 
Ant addresses the state of the league, throws bars for old teammates, welcomes the twin who pulled up to the Twin Cities and lays out the mindset for the year ahead.
 
Everybody's on notice, from the old teammates to the assistant coaches. Plus a first look at the Anthony Edwards 3, the shoe that starts the season.
 
The cage is open. The dog is unleashed. Believe That.
